description: Just as dark matter makes up the invisible framework of the cosmos, Dark Matter Society uncovers the hidden signals within Earth’s vast data archives. We combine data engineering, creative UI/UX, and domain knowledge to take NASA's open science "jukebox" and turn complex planetary observations into actionable, harmonious insights for everyone on Earth.
summary:
EARTH FM is an interactive 3D web application and polyphonic data synthesizer that transforms live NASA Earth-observation datasets into a calming, playable planetary radio station. Styled as a 16-bit retro cybernetic telemetry console, it enables users to combine four core NASA parameters—Sea Surface Temperature, GEOS Aerosols, DYAMOND Carbon Dioxide, and Biosphere Greenness—across an interactive 3D wireframe-and-data globe with timeline availability tracking.
Scientific visualizations are typically dense and exclusively visual, leaving general audiences and blind or low-vision users disconnected from climate science. EARTH FM bridges telemetry, musical harmony, and inclusive design by mapping spatial and thermal gradients to four distinct, soothing chord voices quantized in C Major Pentatonic // F Lydian, complete with a 4-channel DJ mixer, crossfader, and live oscilloscope. Users can probe any coordinate manually, launch automated Satellite Signal Routes with saveable "Orbital Station" presets, or explore completely hands-free via arrow-key navigation, a spoken Audio Narrator, and a real-time plain-English Sonic Transcript.
By turning planetary telemetry into an intuitive, multisensory experience, EARTH FM makes Earth science deeply engaging, calming, and accessible to everyone.
details:
What Does It Do and How Does It Work?

EARTH FM (Earth Information Jukebox // NASA Data Telemetry Console) is an interactive 3D Earth-observation synthesizer and planetary radio console that transforms global NASA satellite datasets into calming, real-time polyphonic music.

  • Interactive 3D Multi-Layer Globe: Users can toggle, layer, and blend four NASA Earth parameters simultaneously on a 3D wireframe-and-data globe equipped with a 3D Scan Plane, Rainbow Spectral Terrain, and a live Map Scale Legend:
    1. Sea Surface Temp (0–30 °C thermal scale, mapped to Deep Voice / Deep Chords)
    2. GEOS Aerosols (0–1 relative strength, mapped to Flowy Voice / Flowy Chords)
    3. DYAMOND CO2 (300–460 ppm concentration scale, mapped to Soft Voice / Soft Chords)
    4. Biosphere / Ocean Chlorophyll (0–1 relative greenness, mapped to Warm Voice / Warm Chords)
    • Hover / Manual Scan Mode: Users drag, click, or use keyboard arrows (DRAG • ROTATE • HOVER • SCAN • CLICK • PIN • ARROWS • MOVE) to lock a target reticle onto any ocean or land coordinate (such as North Pacific Ocean or United States) to inspect live telemetry and hear the corresponding chord blend.
    • Satellite Signal Route (Auto-Play): Users select an Origin and Destination (such as Tokyo, Japan to California Coast, USA), save custom routes as presets (including Congo Rainforest -> Sahara Desert, Trans-Pacific Drift, Indian Ocean Monsoon, Boreal Canopy Expedition, and Saharan Aerosol Highway), and watch the Earth rotate smoothly along the route at a user-controlled transit speed (78 BPM).
  • NASA SVS Ingestion Drawer ([ LOAD NASA DATASET ]): Allows users to switch between preloaded NASA SVS Mission Archives (#3827 ECCO2, #4655 GEOS, #4866 DYAMOND, #5084 GEDI) or upload custom 2:1 equirectangular textures (.png/.jpg) and 360x180 Float32 JSON matrices to re-map any telemetry layer.
  • How It Works Under the Hood: EARTH FM pairs a Three.js 3D spherical renderer with a custom Web Audio API polyphonic synthesizer (ThemedChordEngine). Equirectangular NASA visualization frames and 360x180 Float32 spatial matrices are sampled via 3D raycasting under the pointer reticle or along interpolated satellite routes. Normalized scientific metrics (°C, ppm, and 0–1 relative aerosol/greenness strength) undergo exponential parameter smoothing (0.35s ramp, 1.2s swell) to eliminate audio clicks and jitter, then quantize into consonant intervals in C Major Pentatonic // F Lydian while dynamically modulating filter cutoffs and stereo balance.

What Benefits Does It Have?

  • Multisensory Inclusion for Blind & Low-Vision Users: Replaces purely visual climate charts with arrow-key globe navigation, a spoken Audio Narrator (NARRATOR: ON/OFF), and a live plain-English [ SONIC TRANSCRIPT ] readout displaying the active territory, exact chords and frequencies playing (such as Fmaj7#11 Pad, C2 Sub, and Kalimba D4), and offline channels.
  • Intuitive, Calming Science Communication: Transforms overwhelming multi-variable Earth telemetry into a soothing, playable musical instrument that builds emotional connection and climate literacy for students, educators, and general audiences.
  • Zero-Install Browser Performance & Extensibility: Runs smoothly at 60fps directly in any modern web browser while enabling researchers and educators to ingest custom 2:1 equirectangular datasets without writing code.

What Is the Intended Impact of Our Project?

We aim to transform complex planetary monitoring from passive chart-reading into an engaging, accessible everyday experience. Building on our NASA SVS Ingestion Drawer, our long-term impact roadmap includes:

  • Classrooms & Science Museums: Serving as an interactive, inclusive STEM exhibit where sighted and blind/low-vision learners explore Earth's climate systems side by side through sound.
  • Live Planetary Radio Streams: Connecting the ingestion pipeline directly to live NASA GIBS and Earthdata streams so listeners can tune into real-time cyclones, wildfire aerosol plumes, and seasonal ocean currents as they unfold.
  • Multi-Planetary & Climate-Projection Sonification: Empowering researchers and students to upload future IPCC climate scenarios or extraterrestrial datasets (such as Mars atmospheric and lunar topography maps) into the 2:1 equirectangular / 360x180 Float32 ingestion engine to hear other worlds.

What Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware, or Software Did We Use?

  • Programming Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, GLSL
  • Frontend & 3D Graphics: React, Vite, Three.js, TopoJSON (world-atlas)
  • Audio & Accessibility Engines: Web Audio API, HTML5 Offscreen Canvas Pixel & Float32 Grid Sampler, Web Speech API (speechSynthesis)
  • Hosting & Deployment: Vercel, GitHub
  • APIs: FastAPI
  • Image processing: OpenCV and NumPy.
  • Audio generation: NumPy-based synthesis, with Python’s built-in wave module writing WAV files .
  • Data/config: JSON score files and Python configuration; the code shown doesn’t indicate a database.
  • Design, Hardware & Collaboration: Standard consumer laptops and headphones for spatial audio testing, Visual Studio Code, GitHub, Miro, and Google Gemini / GitHub Copilot (for code scaffolding and metadata-labeled accessibility templates)

How Is Our Project Creative?

  • Reimagining Climate Data as a "Planetary Jukebox": Rather than treating data sonification as harsh scientific beeps, we designed EARTH FM as a nostalgic 16-bit cybernetic radio station and 4-track DJ mixer—complete with a crossfader, oscilloscope, and "Orbital Station" route presets—turning planetary telemetry into an ambient musical instrument anyone enjoys listening to.
  • Harmonically Locked Multi-Layer "Clubbing": Every environmental layer is mapped to a complementary musical timbre (Deep Chords, Flowy Chords, Soft Chords, Warm Chords) and quantized to a shared C Major Pentatonic // F Lydian harmonic matrix so any combination of variables across any coordinate on Earth blends into relaxing, cohesive music.

What Factors Did Your Team Consider?

  • Musical Enjoyability & Anti-Fatigue Design: Raw data changes rapidly across pixels, which can cause jarring pitch jumps. We implemented exponential audio smoothing (0.35s ramp, 1.2s swell) and pentatonic/Lydian scale quantization so listening over extended sessions remains calm and pleasant.
  • Spatial & Temporal Data Gaps: Not all NASA datasets cover both land and ocean or share identical historical timelines (for example, Sea-Surface Temp is unavailable over land). We engineered a smart availability engine that flags missing domains as [DATA NOT AVAILABLE] / OFFLINE and cleanly mutes that channel while the remaining layers keep playing.
  • Accessibility-First Interaction: We ensured every globe action works without a mouse via keyboard shortcuts (ARROWS to move, CLICK/PIN to lock), paired with a debounced spoken Audio Narrator and a live [ SONIC TRANSCRIPT ] so blind and low-vision users never miss visual context.
